evaluation_components.notes: All tutorial tests would be announced, and all assignments would be surprise-based. Best 6 tut marks out of 7 will be considered.
Best X assignment marks out of (X+1) will be considered. Based on the analysis of case-study/design/experiment/video/story (individual/group).

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and participate in all evaluation components.
makeup_policy: Makeup is granted only for genuine cases with valid justification and prior permission of the Instructor-in-charge. There is no makeup for the tutorial test or quiz.
